name: Doomhound
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level antipaladin 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 3, paladin 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect monstrous dog from the plane of shadow
Duration 1 minute/level (D) or until destroyed
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You tear a piece free from the plane of shadow and shape it into a doglike creature loyal to you for the duration of the spell. The doomhound has the statistics of a dire wolf with the following adjustments: It gains a deflection bonus to AC and CMD equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, it is created with hit points equal to your full hit point total and it uses your base attack bonus instead of its own.

You may direct the doomhound as a move action, and it follows your commands as though it were fully trained in all tricks listed under the Handle Animal skill without needing to make a skill check.

The doomhound is considered a magical beast for the purposes of spells and effects, you may only have one doomhound at a time, and it is destroyed when its hit points reach zero.
